result.summary: Backports six pull requests to the 32.x maintenance branch along with release note updates. The changes revert the default PSBT version created in the GUI from v2 back to v0, add `--no-same-owner` to Guix codesigning tar options, disable ARM32 test runs in CI, and fix multiple issues and silent false passes in P2P functional tests.
result.problem: The 32.x branch contains issues requiring fixes for a point release: GUI users experienced compatibility problems due to the GUI defaulting to PSBTv2, Guix codesigning had archive permission issues, ARM32 CI jobs suffered reliability problems, and several functional test assertions in P2P tests were either flaky or trivially passing due to type mismatches.
evidence: Commit dba6a52b6d notes that 'defaulting to [PSBTv2] causes issues for existing users' in the GUI, prompting the reversion to v0.
Commit 6cb4ce2905 details that `p2p_orphan_handling` assertions passed unconditionally regardless of node behavior because `assert_never_requested` compared integer request hashes against strings.
result.scope_notes: This is a multi-commit backport PR combining six distinct PRs (#36405, #36406, #36539, #36615, #36617, #36701) already merged on master.
result.changed_since_previous: Added backports for #36405, #36406, #36539, #36615, and #36617, broadening the scope from only CI changes (#36701) to also include GUI PSBT versioning, Guix codesigning options, and P2P test fixes.
result.card: Backports six pull requests to the 32.x maintenance branch for the 32.2 release. Key changes include reverting GUI-generated PSBTs back to version 0 to resolve compatibility issues for GUI users, adjusting Guix codesign archive ownership options, disabling ARM32 CI tests, and resolving false-pass bugs and flakes in P2P functional tests. All backported commits are already merged into master.

risk.why: Modifies GUI PSBT generation and Guix release packaging scripts; an error in PSBT construction could break transaction export or signing workflows for GUI users.
